name: TradingView
tagline: Where the world charts, chats and trades markets
blurb: TradingView is a social media network, analysis platform and mobile app for traders and investors.
description:
TradingView is a social media network, analysis platform and mobile app for traders and investors.
The platform provides access to market data with a focus on charts, allowing users to do technical analysis.
